yearLabel: Year of assessment 1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027

provenance.source: Income Tax Act 58 of 1962; Unemployment Insurance Contributions Act 4 of 2002; Budget 2026 rate tables; PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, South Africa
provenance.notes: The seven brackets came from PwC on 31 August 2026. The rebates, thresholds and UIF ceiling came from Budget 2026 summaries. The primary rebate of ZAR 17,820 is exactly 18% of the ZAR 99,000 threshold, which is a useful internal consistency check and it holds.

verificationTodo: Confirm the 2026/27 rebates and the UIF monthly ceiling of ZAR 17,712 with SARS.
Confirm the retirement fund contribution deduction limit of 27.5% capped at ZAR 350,000.
omissions: The medical scheme fees tax credit and additional medical expenses credit are not modelled.
Travel allowances, company car fringe benefits and the associated deductions are not modelled.
Only the primary rebate is applied; the secondary and tertiary age rebates are not.

brackets.note: Seven brackets, starting at 18% from the first rand. There is no tax-free band: the tax-free effect comes from the rebate.

rebates.note: A rebate is subtracted from the tax, not from income. The primary rebate of 17,820 is exactly 18% of 99,000, which is why 99,000 is the tax threshold.

uif.note: One percent of remuneration up to a monthly ceiling, matched by the employer. The maximum an employee pays is ZAR 177.12 a month.

retirementDeduction.note: Contributions to a pension, provident or retirement annuity fund are deductible up to 27.5% of the greater of remuneration and taxable income, capped at ZAR 350,000 a year.

regions.name: South Africa
regions.note: South African income tax has no provincial component.

inputSchema.label: Gross remuneration (per month)
inputSchema.help: Gross monthly pay before PAYE. UIF is capped monthly, so a bonus month does not increase your UIF.

inputSchema.label: PAYE deducted (per month)
inputSchema.help: Employees' tax withheld each month, for the annual comparison.

inputSchema.label: Retirement fund contributions
inputSchema.help: Pension, provident and retirement annuity contributions. Deductible up to 27.5% of your remuneration, and never more than ZAR 350,000 a year.
